data.title: Watcher hardening nits from AS-7 review (lock steal race, sentinel tmp suffix, SIGKILL timer)

data.body: Backlog-grade findings from the AS-7 review (none violate a stated criterion; all bounded-consequence). (1) acquireLock stale-steal race: two actors that both observe a stale advance.lock can interleave unlink+create so both believe they hold it — reachable only when a manual/loop tick steals the same >=45min-stale lock in the same instant as the watcher; plan §5 declares the lock etiquette-not-correctness, so this is sanctioned residual risk. Hardening: after wx-create, re-read the lock and confirm pid==self. (2) Sentinel tmp file uses a fixed name (last-human-message.json.tmp); two store processes (server container + CLI container share the bind mount) can interleave write/rename so one rename ENOENTs (caught) or the sentinel briefly holds the lower messageId — never torn, never loses a message (inbox sweep + sentinel>highwater re-trigger); verified with a 2x200-post concurrent hammer (valid JSON, zero tmp orphans). Hardening: unique tmp suffix (pid+random). (3) advance-watcher.mjs SIGKILL grace timer closes over the mutable 'child' variable; with default config unreachable, but if ADVANCE_DEBOUNCE_S is set below the fixed 15s kill grace, a timed-out tick's SIGKILL timer can kill a just-spawned successor tick (consequence: one wasted tick, logged, next message retries). Hardening: clear the kill timer in the exit handler or capture the child in the closure. Also cosmetic: SKIP log line every poll while a foreign lock is held with a pending sentinel (~360 lines per 30min loop tick, bounded by 5MiB rotation); pid-guard read-then-write TOCTOU for two simultaneously started manual watchers (launchd + fire-time wx lock make it moot).

PLAN (cto-owen): triage of Priya's five AS-7 findings. FIX 1-4: (1) verify-after-create in acquireLock (shrinks double-steal, lock stays etiquette — explicitly not eliminated); (2) unique sentinel tmp suffix pid+random in store.js writeHumanSentinel, best-effort orphan unlink; (3) capture spawned child in a per-fire const + clear SIGKILL grace timer on exit; (4) SKIP log dedupe per episode, mirroring lastBadSentinel pattern. WON'T-FIX 5: pid-guard TOCTOU — courtesy guard, launchd + fire-time wx lock bound it; one-line sanctioning comment only. Preferred lift: makeLockOps exported from watcher for fs-backed in-container tests (mountless invariant holds; fs-in-tempdir fine). Tests extend store.test.js + watcher.test.js; suite via docker compose, no real claude spawns. Est: small — ~40 lines code, ~80 lines tests.
